body.name: Residual cross-cumulant system
body.construction: For \((\alpha,\delta)\in\mathbb C^2\), form \(U_\alpha=X_1-\alpha X_2\), \(V_\delta=X_3-\delta X_2\), and \(F(\alpha,\delta)=(F_{11},F_{21},F_{12})^\top=(\kappa(U_\alpha,V_\delta),\kappa(U_\alpha,U_\alpha,V_\delta),\kappa(U_\alpha,V_\delta,V_\delta))^\top\).
